stories.title: Musk regrets nearly $500M in midterm spending and says he is not MAGA
stories.line: Musk says he regrets nearly $500M in midterm spending backing Republicans and denies being MAGA, while also disputing Ukraine's Starlink account.

stories.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, above target range
stories.line: Anthropic has priced its IPO at $83 a share, above its target range, with trading set to begin Thursday.

stories.title: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth, 50 years after launch
stories.line: NASA's Voyager 1 probe has now traveled one light-day from Earth, a distance where signals take a full day to arrive.

stories.title: Waymo suspends driverless freeway rides in all markets after California ban
stories.line: Waymo has paused driverless freeway rides in all its markets after California banned its robotaxis from state freeways following two incidents.

stories.title: Musician Ketch Secor urges country artists to break silence on assault rifles
stories.line: After the Nashville school shooting, country musician Ketch Secor urges fellow artists to speak out on gun policy despite fear of fan backlash.

stories.title: Trump, Xi and Putin set to hold rare trilateral summit in China
stories.line: Trump, Xi and Putin are reportedly set to meet together in China, with no confirmed outcomes or agreements yet.

stories.title: Patel skips House threats hearing for second straight year after Mar-a-Lago gala
stories.line: FBI Director Kash Patel skipped a House hearing on US threats, days after attending a $50,000-access Mar-a-Lago gala.

stories.title: U.S. warns citizens in Bahrain as Iran threatens the monarchy over Fifth Fleet
stories.line: The U.S. has warned Americans in Bahrain after new Iranian attacks, and Iran has threatened the Bahraini monarchy over U.S. naval presence.

stories.title: US indicts Russian national accused of spying on Palantir for Moscow
stories.line: A Russian national was indicted in the US for allegedly acting as a Russian agent, spying on Palantir and its workers over its work for Ukraine.

stories.title: Maryland teens sue after AI mistakes Doritos bag for gun, police detain them
stories.line: Four Maryland high school students were handcuffed by police after an AI gun-detection system mistook a Doritos bag for a weapon, and they are suing.
